name: A Fortnight at Frenni Fazclaire's 2
source:
A Fortnight at Frenni Fazclaire's 2 is a mature tale that takes place over fourteen nights at the newest branch of Frenni Fazclaire's, a night club in which the main performers and draw are animatronic women that parody characters from the famous Five Nights at Freddy's line of games. You play as the new club's Chief Engineer as you dive into the mystery surrounding four of Frenni Fazclaire's quirky, prototype animatronics: Aurora the Tiger, Chi the Bird, Mia Mangle, and Roxy the Wolf.

[From [url=https://night-fox-works.itch.io/a-fortnight-at-frenni-fazclaires-2]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《弗雷尼·法兹克莱尔的两周》是一个成熟的故事，故事发生在弗雷尼·法兹克莱尔最新分店的十四个晚上，这是一家夜总会，主要表演者和画作都是模仿著名游戏《玩具熊的五夜后宫》系列游戏中的电子动画女性。你扮演新俱乐部的首席工程师，深入了解Frenni Fazclaire的四个古怪电子原型玩具的神秘面纱：老虎奥罗拉、鸟奇、米娅·​​曼格和狼罗克西。

[来自[url=https://night-fox-works.itch.io/a-fortnight-at-frenni-fazclaires-2]itch.io[/url]]
